subject: MAP + Eval sprint — AWS private offer, billing path & stall recovery
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@astramed.com>, Sara Voss <sara.voss@astramed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff + eval sprint — confirmation on AWS private offer & billing path

Thanks again for the productive demo today — great questions from the ML and infra teams. Per our call, I've put together a minimal MAP to keep the eval moving and avoid the procurement stall. Key checkpoints below — please confirm if these align to your timeline and whether Procurement needs any additional artifacts to proceed with an AWS private offer: 

- Dec 13: eval kickoff (sandbox access + test corpus)
- Dec 20: integration smoke tests (latency, cost-per-token snapshot)
- Dec 23: acceptance criteria run (3 example flows + perf baseline)
- Dec 31: tentative signoff on POC (customer requests 2-week buffer possible)
- Jan 07: expected PO issuance for production private offer (if POC accepted)

Open items for Procurement: can you confirm whether AstraMed will accept an AWS Marketplace private offer (Redwood issues via AWS billing) or if you require direct vendor invoicing to accounts payable? Procurement indicated they prefer Marketplace billing for centralized tracking but that created the stall today.

I've attached a lightweight MPA spreadsheet (mpa-draft-stall-recovery.xlsx) that maps owners and dates. Also attaching our baseline quote for the AWS private offer (aws-private-offer-quote-ast-20261210.pdf).

If Marketplace is acceptable, next steps on our side: convert quote into an AWS private offer, provide DocuSign SOW for signature, and coordinate invoice contact. If not, we'll outline a direct-invoice path but that usually adds ~2 weeks to onboarding while AP verifies vendor details.

Can you please respond by EOD Monday with Procurement's preferred billing route? If helpful, we can jump on a quick call with your finance team to unblock.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: mpa-draft-stall-recovery.xlsx, aws-private-offer-quote-ast-20261210.pdf
From: Liam Parker <liam.parker@astramed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Sara Voss <sara.voss@astramed.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@astramed.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + eval sprint — confirmation on AWS private offer & billing path

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear MAP. Quick responses from Procurement: they do prefer AWS Marketplace private offer for central vendor tracking. The stall happened because our legal team paused on countersigning the SOW until Billing & AP confirm the invoice path. 

Two asks from Procurement: 
1) Can Redwood accept issuance of the purchase via AWS Private Offer (Marketplace billing) and have the invoice routed to procure@astramed.com?
2) We need a short summary of what will appear on the invoice (SKU names & quantities) so AP can map to the PO template.

If you can provide the SKU breakdown and confirm the Marketplace billing flow, Procurement is ready to issue a PO. Also — we may request a 2-week extension on the final acceptance date to Dec 31 if Redwood is amenable (eval resources oversubscribed on our side).

— Liam
Liam Parker
Director, Cloud Platform — AstraMed Systems
liam.parker@astramed.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@astramed.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + eval sprint — confirmation on AWS private offer & billing path

Hi Liam — short answers and practical path: we fully support AWS Marketplace Private Offers. Two supported flows: 

Option A — AWS Private Offer (recommended):
- Redwood creates private offer in AWS Marketplace tied to your account
- AstraMed accepts the offer and issues PO via the Marketplace flow
- Billing flows through AWS Marketplace (one invoice line per SKU, monthly invoice to AP)
- Typical timeline: < 5 business days to turn quote -> private offer after we receive signed SOW/quote

Option B — Direct vendor invoice (slower):
- AstraMed issues PO directly to Redwood, Redwood invoices AP on net30
- Requires vendor onboarding (W-9 / vendor profile) and usually adds ~2 weeks

Attached is the quote we referenced (aws-private-offer-quote-ast-20261210.pdf) with SKU-level lines you can drop into your PO. I'll also add a SKU summary paragraph below for AP: 
- RDW-INF-BASE: Dedicated inference pool (vCPU/GPU unit), qty: 1 (committed)
- RDW-INF-ADDON-KV: KV cache capacity (per-month units), qty: estimate 1
- RDW-SUPPORT-ENT: Enterprise support (monthly)

Grace — Karthik and Finance: can you confirm whether we can offer a one-time 2-week eval extension without changing the commercial terms? Procurement asked about courtesy credit if POC runs into oversubscription.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521 — I'll log this message there and add the private-offer task.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Procurement <procure@astramed.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + eval sprint — confirmation on AWS private offer & billing path

Thanks Liam and team — copying finance & legal owners internally. A few clarifications from Billing: 
- We can support monthly Marketplace billing in arrears, Net 30 by default.
- For POC/PO sizing: confirm whether PO will be for a committed pool (recommended for predictable latency) or metered usage. If committed, we can lock pricing for the Q1 term.
- We can offer a one-time evaluation credit (up to 20% of the POC spend) if the POC is delayed due to customer-side resource constraints. That would be applied as a credit on the first Marketplace invoice.

I've attached a slightly annotated MAP that indicates who signs what and when (mpa-draft-stall-recovery.xlsx). Naomi — can you produce a concise Marketplace acceptance checklist for the customer (legal checklist + AP contact mapping)?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Sara Voss <sara.voss@astramed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@astramed.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + eval sprint — confirmation on AWS private offer & billing path

On Tue, Dec 15, 2026 at 11:07 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Liam and team — copying finance & legal owners internally. A few clarifications from Billing:

Thanks — Procurement confirmed: AWS Private Offer flow is preferred. We will issue the PO via Marketplace once we have the private-offer link and the SKU breakdown. AP requests that the invoice flow to procure@astramed.com and that line items match our PO template (attached).

We are also asking for the short evaluation extension to Dec 31 — can Redwood confirm that you can keep the POC sandbox active through that date? If Redwood can provide the 2-week buffer and the proposed 20% courtesy credit (applied to the first invoice if POC delays are customer-caused), Procurement will proceed with internal approvals.

Attached: AstraMed_PO_Template.pdf

Thanks,
Sara Voss
Senior Procurement Manager, AstraMed Systems
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Liam Parker <liam.parker@astramed.com>, Sara Voss <sara.voss@astramed.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + eval sprint — confirmation on AWS private offer & billing path

Appreciate the quick turnaround — confirming everything below so we all have a single source of truth:

1) Marketplace path: Redwood will convert the attached quote into an AWS Private Offer for AstraMed. The private-offer link will be sent to Liam and Sara; once accepted, Procurement can issue the PO through AWS Marketplace.
2) Billing: AWS Marketplace invoice to be routed to procure@astramed.com. Redwood will include SKU-level lines matching the quote PDF. Billing cadence: monthly in arrears, Net 30.
3) POC extension: Redwood confirms sandbox access through Dec 31 (2-week extension). We'll apply a one-time courtesy credit up to 20% of POC spend if AstraMed's internal delays cause the extension. 
4) Legal/SOW: We'll send a DocuSign with the SOW and a redline-ready Word doc (redlines_AstraMed_SOW.docx). Please return countersigned SOW or the PO in Marketplace to avoid additional delays.

Next steps (short list):
- Today: Jordan to create AWS private offer and share link (HubSpot deal RDW-4521-AST).
- Tomorrow: Legal sends DocuSign SOW + redlines doc attached.
- EOD Mon: Procurement to confirm PO issuance path; if PO is ready, Redwood will finish private offer conversion same day.
- Dec 20: 30-minute alignment call to confirm AP contact and confirm the first invoice expectations.

Thanks — I'll follow up in HubSpot and attach the finalized MPA spreadsheet.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redlines_AstraMed_SOW.docx, mpa-draft-stall-recovery.xlsx
